stemMd: Two fair coins are tossed and a fair six-sided die is rolled, independently. What is the probability of two heads and an even die result?
explanationMd: Two heads have probability 1/4; an even die result has probability 3/6=1/2. Independence gives their product 1/8.

distractorRationale.a: This treats the die condition as one face rather than three.
distractorRationale.e: This adds probabilities rather than multiplying.
